title: More Privileged Role Administrators than the tenant needs

excludeAccounts.text: Emergency access accounts to leave out of the count, by name or with * and ? wildcards

maxPrivilegedRoleAdmins.text: Privileged Role Administrators above which the risk outweighs the convenience

messages.businessImpact: Privileged Role Administrator can grant every other privileged role, including Global Administrator. Extra holders are a second path to full control of the directory.
remediation: Keep the role on a small set of eligible administrators through Privileged Identity Management.
List emergency accounts in the exclusions for this rule.
messages.cannotSee: Same emergency-account blind spot as ACC-001. Eligible versus permanent is ACC-004.
